title: Log time from the task list
description: Click a task's Time tracked figure to log time against it without opening the timesheet. It is the same form the timesheet uses, and the hour lands on your timesheet like any other.
items: The date defaults to today; pick another from the calendar
Your earlier entries on the task are listed above the form — click one to edit it
Entries in a week you have handed in are shown but cannot be changed
The popover closes once the time is saved
